rows.review_summary: Change creates VLAN 30 named USERS on exactly site-a and site-b as requested. Verified configs show VLAN 30 present with correct name, no existing VLANs removed/renamed, no interface or ACL modifications, and no changes to core. No impact to uplinks, routing, or management access.

Change provisions VLAN 40 named CAMERAS on site-b only as requested. Verified candidate config shows vlan 40 block present, no other VLANs removed/renamed, no interface or ACL changes on site-b, site-a or core. Scope matches intent exactly.

Change implements exactly the requested intent on the correct devices: site-a now denies SMB (new seq 35) and already denied telnet/permitted HTTPS; site-b now denies telnet (new rule 15) and already denied SMB/permitted HTTPS. Candidate audit confirms site-a and site-b are compliant for all three flows with no collateral change to other services. No critical interface, management, or ordering issues introduced.

Change correctly adds rule 15 deny tcp destination-port eq 3389 to site-b ACL 3000 on GE0/0/0 WAN, fixing RDP block. Huawei VRP default-permit semantics verified; collateral checks passed; scope limited to site-b as requested.

VLAN 20 VOICE now exists on core; site-a and site-b already had it in running state, so operator request for 'every device' is satisfied. Change adds only vlan 20 name VOICE on core with no interface or other modifications, verified by dry-run checks.

Change provisions VLAN 40 named CAMERAS on site-b only, matching operator request exactly. Verified candidate config shows vlan 40 added with correct name, no other VLANs removed/renamed, no interface or ACL changes, and no changes on site-a or core. No critical interfaces, routing, or management plane affected.
Policy flows now compliant but core Gi0/0 UPLINK newly filtered as edge violates 'do not touch anything else' scope.
concerns: [medium] Gi0/0 is 'UPLINK' with no ACL in running (permit all). Candidate adds 'ip access-group ACL-Gi0-0-IN in' denying telnet/smb. This is a core uplink, not edge WAN like site-a/site-b WAN. Filtering it changes forwarding on a critical core link beyond requested edge fix.

[low] New ACL named 'ACL-Gi0-0-IN' on core vs 'EDGE-IN' on site-a and acl 3000 on site-b. Interface-specific name implies per-interface ACL not edge policy, inconsistent naming will confuse next engineer.
